title: Sustainable fashion awareness
summary: Listening to consumer perspectives through more than 130 survey responses.
body:
A student group research activity examining awareness of sustainable fashion and patterns in consumer behaviour.

My contribution

I helped collect and organize more than 130 survey responses for analysis and reporting, and contributed to the written report and presentation of findings.

The focus

The project connected sustainability questions with consumer perspectives, turning a collection of survey responses into material the team could analyze and communicate.
